categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies ci/test/ scripts (00_setup_env*.sh, 02_run_container.py, 03_test_script.sh) to add tcpdump packet inspection to CI runs.
categories.rationale: This PR adds tcpdump monitoring to CI jobs to detect and fail on unexpected outbound TCP, UDP, or DNS traffic. Adding automated checks ensures test hermeticity and prevents CI runners from making external network queries.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and introduces test execution monitoring across unit, functional, and fuzz test suites to detect network leaks.
categories.rationale: It enforces isolation and hermeticity across all test suites by failing if tests emit outbound packets or non-loopback DNS queries. While worthwhile for detecting tests that leak requests to the public internet, it is non-critical and reasonably deferrable.
